criteria.statement: A backend test shows the judge input carries attached excerpt ids and text, deciding rule ids under a separate label, and game-state lines when the case has a state
A test shows the judge input is built identically for different models, caps and arms
A test shows the rubric revision identifier changed and per-case comparison across revisions is refused
A test shows the evaluation prompt loader loads the combo catalog when combo enrichment is on and records the flag
A test shows evaluation answer calls pass no timeout, retry, or reasoning-effort override beyond the SDK default
A test shows records carry `allDecidingRulesInPrompt`, reasoning tokens, reported effort, and `unpriced` instead of a $0 cost; `goldRuleInPrompt` keeps its meaning
`gpt-6-luna` is in the rate table with a check date and the dry run prints each rate with its date
